answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the cedar is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, converted to a slow vesting stream, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Work waits on the violet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ripple of the next round.
